redistribution_policy: Metadata, URLs, SHA-256 checksums, effective dates, and short statutory quotations (<50 words per rule) are released under CC0 1.0; full HTML/PDF snapshots retain source-specific copyright (ACL / conference organising committees) and are archived locally for audit verification only.

policies.document_title: EMNLP 2020 Call for Papers & Reproducibility Checklist
policies.source_terms: ACL Website Terms / Copyright Association for Computational Linguistics
policies.notes: First year of the ACL/EMNLP Reproducibility Checklist (Dodge et al., 2019; Magnusson et al., 2023). Answering the checklist at submission was required, but reporting every item (e.g., compute budget) inside the paper text remained optional if answered 'No'.

policies.document_title: EMNLP 2021 Call for Papers & Responsible NLP Checklist
policies.source_terms: ACL Website Terms / Copyright Association for Computational Linguistics
policies.notes: Incorporates ethics review and responsible data/reproducibility checklist items (Rogers et al., 2021); dedicated Limitations section not yet mandatory.

policies.document_title: EMNLP 2022 Call for Main Conference Papers
policies.source_terms: ACL Website Terms / Copyright Association for Computational Linguistics
policies.notes: Explicit transition point: EMNLP 2022 introduces a mandatory 'Limitations' section for all papers (does not count toward page limit) and requires explicit discussion of ethical considerations where relevant.

policies.document_title: EMNLP 2023 Call for Papers & ACL 2023 AI Writing Assistance Policy
policies.source_terms: ACL Website Terms / Copyright Association for Computational Linguistics
policies.notes: First EMNLP edition following ChatGPT's release (Nov 2022) and the January 2023 ACL Policy on AI Writing Assistance (Boyd-Graber et al., 2023).

policies.document_title: EMNLP 2024 Call for Main Conference Papers & ARR Responsible NLP Checklist
policies.source_terms: ACL Website Terms / Copyright Association for Computational Linguistics
policies.notes: Continues mandatory Limitations section and ARR Responsible NLP Checklist (items B2 and C1).

policies.document_title: EMNLP 2025 Call for Main Conference Papers & ARR Public Checklist Appendices Announcement
policies.source_terms: ACL Website Terms / Copyright Association for Computational Linguistics
policies.notes: From June 2025 (ARR announcement), Responsible NLP Checklists are appended to camera-ready PDFs. To preserve longitudinal comparability across 2020-2026, our primary audit excludes appended checklists and evaluates only main text and ordinary appendices.
